findings.title: Prevent the lookup goroutine from blocking after cancellation.
findings.rationale:
If ctx.Done() wins, ResolveContext returns with no receiver on done. When d.Lookup(name) later returns, Line 28 blocks forever on the unbuffered send. Use a channel with capacity one. This lets the goroutine exit after the lookup completes.

Proposed fix

-	done := make(chan result) +	done := make(chan result, 1)
